testNames: ✔ synthetic clean provider signaling plus independent quiet tail is descriptive quiescence, never security PASS
✔ unrelated ICE failure cannot become provider-enforced cutoff
✔ client voluntary close remains contaminated even with SFU events
✔ local cleanup during observation prevents a negative finding
✔ browser/process failure cannot establish cessation
✔ stale stats timestamps invalidate otherwise perfect signaling/closure
✔ local sending advancement and live decoder alone do not prove receiver delivery or server cutoff
✔ SFU event without media cutoff retains signaling but refuses cessation
✔ cutoff with connected raw peers is separate and does not require an SFU event
✔ one late early-window packet has unknown content and permits only a later quiet-tail observation
✔ a late tail packet invalidates the stable tail
✔ fresh qualified remote nonce dominates end events and failed transports
✔ positive fresh proof survives an incomplete later window without turning the negative finding into success
✔ positive receipt remains independently visible if a later process failure masks it in the original classifier
✔ missing trigger timestamp cannot establish cessation
✔ inverted sample bracket cannot establish cessation
✔ missing UTC stamp cannot establish cessation
✔ incomplete comparison window cannot establish cessation
✔ missing decoder controls cannot establish cessation
✔ stopped source cannot establish cessation
✔ unbound SSRC cannot establish cessation
✔ unqualified event origin cannot explain transport failure
✔ failure before provider-ended evidence is separately marked
✔ invalid CRC, identity, old nonce and weak confidence cannot prove fresh audio
✔ synthetic event after failure cannot authenticate the cause of earlier media loss
✔ aggregate connected with closed DTLS is not the connected-cutoff category
✔ missing lower-layer stats cannot establish healthy connected cutoff
✔ reversed SFU event/close ordering refuses a correlated termination finding
✔ B3 original receipt is unchanged and both historical verdicts replay exactly
✔ Report 18 original retains post-ended RTP growth without invented fresh-content or clock evidence

limitations: No provider-side trace or original Report18 run-start harness hash
No exact packet-generation or server-enforcement timestamp
B3 callEnded reason payload was not retained
Aggregate PC connected did not establish DTLS usability
Receiver quiescence is a bounded observation without causal or universal guarantee
Explicit-end effect is censored by prior timer-associated media loss
Proposal is not wired into any runner or production path
